title: Multi-Table Join: Order Items with Products and Customers
realWorldScenario: Customer support needs a consolidated view of line items purchased by customer "Aarav Patel".
questionStatement: Write a query joining `orders`, `customers`, `order_items`, and `products` to list all products bought by `Aarav Patel`. Return `order_id`, `product_name` (as `name`), `quantity`, and `unit_price`, sorted by `order_id` ascending.
starterCode:
-- Multi-table join for Aarav Patel purchases
SELECT
  o.id AS order_id,
  p.name AS product_name,
  oi.quantity,
  oi.unit_price
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE c.name = 'Aarav Patel'
ORDER BY o.id ASC, p.name ASC;
hints: Join orders to customers, then order_items to orders, then products to order_items.
Filter where customer name is Aarav Patel.

testCases.description: Verify items purchased across Aarav Patel orders
